# CANDIDATE: MIDDAY_RIBBON_FLIP_VOLUME_SPIKE_LONG

**Filed:** 2026-07-09
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)
**Type:** new_trigger
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

A bullish EMA ribbon flip (8-EMA crossing above 21-EMA) with a volume spike and bullish engulfing after 11:00 ET indicates renewed intraday buying pressure. This setup aims to capture mean-reversion bots and short-covering rallies that often occur after the initial morning drift, especially when the 8/21 EMA crossover aligns with a surge in participation and a strong bullish candle.

## Mechanism

**Entry:** After 11:00 ET, if prior_8EMA <= prior_21EMA and current_8EMA > current_21EMA (bullish flip) AND volume > 2 * average_volume_20bars AND the bar shows bullish engulfing (close > prior_open AND open < prior_close) then go long at bar close.  
**Exit:** Initial stop at the low of the flip bar (chart-stop). Exit half position at 2R (profit target = 2 × risk). Let the remaining half trail with a 15% trailing stop from the high-water mark OR exit on close below 8-EMA, whichever occurs first.  
**Regime filters:** Only consider when ADX < 20 (non-trending) and VIX between 12‑25. Avoid first hour (09:30‑10:30 ET) and last 30 minutes (15:20‑15:50 ET) of session.
